moments.title: Premier League Transfer Window Buzz
moments.blurb: The summer transfer window for the Premier League remains open until August 31, with clubs still active in signing players ahead of the 2026/27 season which kicks off on August 21.

angles.name: Transfer Talk
angles.copy: Who's still on the move? The Premier League transfer window is wide open, with clubs scrambling for those last-minute deals before the big kick-off on August 21st. Any big names you're hoping to see arrive at your club?

angles.name: Season Anticipation
angles.copy: The new Premier League season starts in less than three weeks! But first, who needs to sign who to be ready? The transfer window is still buzzing with speculation. What's your club's biggest need?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield will be held on Sunday, August 16, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal against FA Cup winners Manchester City.

angles.name: Cardiff Host
angles.copy: Principality Stadium, Cardiff is gearing up to host the FA Community Shield on August 16th! Arsenal take on Manchester City. Who's heading to the capital for the big game?

angles.name: Big Game Build-up
angles.copy: It's the traditional curtain-raiser! Arsenal vs Manchester City in the Community Shield on August 16th. Who's taking home the first silverware of the season?

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Boardmasters Festival, combining music and surf, runs from Wednesday, August 5th to Sunday, August 9th in Newquay, Cornwall.

angles.name: Surf & Sound
angles.copy: Boardmasters is nearly here! From August 5th-9th, Newquay comes alive with music, surf, and good vibes. Who are you most excited to see on the lineup?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Only a few days until Boardmasters kicks off in Newquay! Get ready for five days of incredible music and beach action. Are you heading down to Cornwall?

moments.title: Roots Picnic UK Debut
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8th and 9th, bringing a blend of hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: The Roots Picnic is coming to Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend, August 8th & 9th! Get ready for a huge dose of hip hop and culture right here in London. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Hip Hop Vibes
angles.copy: Big news for hip hop fans! Roots Picnic makes its UK debut this weekend in London. Expect incredible music and an unforgettable atmosphere. Are you going?

moments.title: August Weather Outlook
moments.blurb: The start of August looks settled and dry for much of the UK, with above-average temperatures and potential for further hot spells, especially across southern parts of the UK.

angles.name: Summer Sunshine
angles.copy: Hello, August! The forecast is looking settled, dry, and warm for many of us, with more hot spells possible down south. What are your plans for soaking up the summer sunshine?

angles.name: Heatwave Watch
angles.copy: Another warm start to August for the UK, with the potential for very warm conditions in the south. Are you hoping for another heatwave or ready for cooler days?

angles.name: Long Weekend North

angles.name: Monday Off
angles.copy: A well-deserved day off for many in Scotland tomorrow with the Summer Bank Holiday! Make the most of it!

moments.title: Ludwig Season 2 Premieres on BBC

angles.name: New BBC Drama
angles.copy: Looking for your next TV binge? 'Ludwig' Season 2 is coming to BBC this month! What was your favourite moment from the first series?

angles.name: Netflix Comedy

moments.title: Devon EV Charger Trial Begins
moments.blurb: A Government-funded trial of 30 new on-street electric vehicle charging points is set to begin in Devon in early to mid-August, aiming to improve charging access for residents.

angles.name: Greener Devon
angles.copy: Devon is trialling 30 new on-street EV chargers this month, making it easier for residents to go electric. A big step towards a greener county! What do you think?

angles.name: Charging Up
angles.copy: Exciting news for Devon drivers! New electric vehicle charging points are being rolled out this month. Will this help you make the switch to electric?
